tool_signatures.name: Booklet
tool_signatures.description: two pages per sheet side in folding order, for double-sided printing (undo brings the pages back)

tool_signatures.name: Remove hidden information on save
tool_signatures.description: creator program, dates, XMP data, comment authors and the location/camera data of photos. Location data of inserted photos is always removed

tool_signatures.name: Text recognition (OCR)
tool_signatures.description: recognizes scanned pages and adds an invisible text layer, so the text can be searched, selected and copied. English and Turkish, fully offline (Tesseract). Suggested when a scanned document is opened; scans below 150 dpi get an explanation instead of a long, failing run

tool_signatures.name: Table to Excel
tool_signatures.description: draw a box around a table and save it as .xlsx. Ruled tables use the lines on the page, other tables the position of the text; amounts become numbers, codes and dates stay text. Scanned tables can be exported after text recognition
